cohort: The study reviewed 320 cesarean deliveries performed by family medicine faculty at a single midwestern residency program between January 2012 and March 2021.
finding: The average total surgical procedure time was 64.3 minutes and incision-to-delivery time was 9.5 minutes, with average 1-min and 5-min Apgar scores of 7.5 and 8.7 respectively, and no significant correlations were found between Apgar scores and procedure times.
mod_finding: The study described average surgical times and neonatal Apgar scores for cesarean deliveries, finding no significant correlation between procedure times and Apgar scores.
